evaluation.overall_comment: The translation successfully preserves the informational content and dialogue structure of the original physics podcast but suffers from severe linguistic impurity. It is heavily polluted with English ('pattern', 'fringes'), Dutch ('jammais'), and French/Italian false friends ('tenuie', 'superficie', 'physicistes'). Key Interlingua morphological rules are ignored (e.g., missing plural verb markers, non-standard adjective forms), and technical terminology is frequently inaccurate or untranslated.
